name: plie-squat-dumbbell
title: Plié Squat: Dumbbell
primer: This version of the squat is done with a dumbbell and uses a wide, turned-out stance like a ballet plié.
steps: Stand with your feet 2-4 inches wider than your shoulders, with your toes pointed out at a 45 degree angle.
Grasp a dumbbell with both hands in the centre of your body.
Keep your knees slightly bent and your back straight.
Squat down as if you were going to sit in a chair, bringing your thighs parallel to the floor.
With a controlled motion return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your feet planted firmly on the floor throughout this exercise.
